Compare the retrieved data: - If the official results and at least two news sources list Zhang Zhanshuo as the gold‑medalist with a time of 3:41.28, the claim is confirmed. - If they list a different medal, a different time, or no mention of him in that event, the claim is not confirmed and any differing figures constitute the reported contradiction.
